posts.body:
Hello RPG Makers!
Disclaimer: This is my first post, so any feedback is welcome. I have searched for this issue in the forums and haven't found a person with the same problem, so I'll be glad if someone can help me out with this:
Context:
A)
My levels have names, they aren't numbers. For example:
Level 1 is "Novice"
Level 2 is "Knight"
B )
I have achieved that with the following Plug-In:
Spoiler
Code:
Window_StatusBase.prototype.drawActorLevel = function(actor, x, y) {
    let levelName = null;
    if(actor.level == 1){
      levelName = "Novice"
    }
    if(actor.level == 2){
      levelName = "Knight"

    this.drawText(levelName, x, y, 36, "right");
};
C)
My Level Up Message in Terms is the following:
Code:
%1 is now %2: %3!
Issue/Problem:
The return message when I level up to Level 2 reads: "Actor is now Rank: 2"
And I want the message to read: "Actor is now Rank: Knight"
thanks in advance!

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
TheSaladus
posts.body:
Hello Canned_Dinosaur,
Thanks for the fast reply and clear answer. I'll definitely read the Support Post Template for future posts.
___
First of all, yes, you are right, the code I pasted on the post is missing a "{".
That was, in fact, an error of mine when posting this thread. Because the plug-in actually has much more ranks, it goes up to 10 ranks. But I didn't want to paste the whole code here, so I trimmed it for simplicity; and in the trimming I missed the "{". Nice catch.
The plug-in I'm using for this is actually a text given to me by a kind stranger in a Discord channel. I don't believe the plug-in has a name or something. I don't have any other plug-ins at the moment.
____
Secondly, thanks for the solution. I will try it out and report on the results. I hope this post helps people in the future with the same problem.
